resources.string: Dynamic colors follow your wallpaper on Android 12+.
How often live metrics refresh while a screen is visible. Longer intervals use less battery. Nothing is polled in the background.
Graphs are kept on this device only while you use the Monitor screen. Up to 2000 samples per metric.

Internet: only for the network diagnostics you start yourself (ping, DNS). Network state: to show whether you are on Wi-Fi or mobile data. Installed apps list: to find games and apps you may choose to stop; it never leaves your phone. Stop background processes: only for apps you confirm. Draw over other apps: only for the FPS overlay. Change system settings: only to dim the screen during a game. Wake lock: only the Wi-Fi low-latency lock during a game. FrameX reads no personal files.
When on, the Play button in Games checks temperature, memory, battery saver and refresh rate, then picks the profile. When off, it applies the game\'s own saved profile.

A small draggable box over your game, no root needed. FPS is measured exactly when Shizuku is connected. Without it, pressing Play asks to capture the screen and the overlay shows an ESTIMATE (marked ~, about ±2 FPS) counted from real screen updates; if you decline, it shows n/a. It appears while a game from your list is running.
Needs the permission to draw over other apps.
